newsitem.title: USA: A. Schulman sees improved Q3 results.
newsitem.headline: A. Schulman sees improved Q3 results.

text.p: A. Schulman Inc said on Thursday that it expects to report improved third quarter earnings over the same period last year, due to solid orders and stable resin prices.
In last year's third quarter ended May 31, 1996, A. Schulman reported earnings of $12.1 million, or $0.32 a share, on sales of $254.4 million.
A. Schulman said it expects to receive funds from its affiliates during the fiscal year in addition to the $56 million in gross dividends it received from foreign affiliates in March 1997.
This cash will fund a three million shares stock repurchase program, subject to market conditions, Schulman said.
The company has already repurchased one million shares since the beginning of the fiscal year and will make the remaining purchases over the next 18 months, Schulman said.

Schulman said its board has approved two new capital projects. It is increasing capacity at its specialty chemicals facility in Givet, France and making improvements at its specialty compounding unit in Sharon, Ohio, Schulman said.
